translations.web: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
